body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Reduce the next incoming Damage you take by 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Gain +1 Composure against the next attack targeting you until the start of your next turn.
Extend the Damage protection to one willing ally within 2 units.

rider.title: Strain - Barrier
rider.html: If you accepted Strain for this card, the first creature to push or pull you before your next turn moves you 1 fewer unit.
